overview: The Battambang Variation reaches the position after 1.a3 e5 2.Nc3 (also 1.Nc3 e5 2.a3 in the games). White plays a quiet flank move and then Nc3, keeping options for e4, g3 or b4. Black takes the centre with ...e5 and ...d5 and equalises easily.

white_ideas.idea: Follow with e4 or g3 and Bg2, keeping flexible
Use a3 to prepare b4 and queenside space

typical_structures.structure: Black pawn centre against White flexible set-up

character.notes: Quiet, hardly forcing play with no obvious tension.

gambit.notes: No material is given up on purpose.

soundness.notes: Sound but little more than a waiting move.

structure.notes: White has not decided on a centre.

approach.notes: Almost never played by strong players, chosen for surprise.

level.notes: Easy to play but no special plans.

character.reason: Quiet flank opening with no sharpness and no real solidity.

soundness.reason: Harmless for White but not worse.

level.reason: Little theory and no specific plan.
